processing.description: Read the text of the PDF (sha256 fd1ece746563…). Found each of the 1 quoted statement(s) word for word on PDF page(s) 8, and the 2 context sentence(s) the scope relies on, before publishing.

Published each number exactly as printed, with its statement in the value's note. A range 'A-B%' is published as its low end A and high end B (dimension 'bound'); nothing was computed, rounded or combined with any other source.
The executive summary gives no year in the sentence; chapter 5 (p. 56) states the same 75% for 2030, which is the period published.

published_value.quote: The total cost of ownership of a 100% e-ammonia or e-methanol-fuelled containership would be 75% higher than a conventional containership operating on fossil fuels.

scope.basis: Total cost of ownership in 2030 of a 9,600 TEU containership with a 58 MW engine at 16 knots, 100,000 nautical miles a year, running on 100% e-ammonia or e-methanol, compared with heavy fuel oil: vessel modifications, bunkering and fuel costs (Figure 5.7, IEA analysis; port charges and handling fees excluded). Chapter 5 states the same 75% per tonne-kilometre. Projection.

title: Extra cost of a containership running on e-fuels in 2030 (IEA)
